将纯文本和 Markdown 转换为带原件与字符定位的标准内容块: Convert plain text and Markdown into standard content blocks with originals and character locations
将文本和多模态输入转换为带来源定位的标准内容块: Convert text and multimodal inputs into standard content blocks with source locations
原生文件数组，可直接上传或绑定上游文件；与 text 至少提供一个，最多 100: Native file array: upload files or bind upstream files; provide files or text, with at most 100 files sharing one MIME type
已上传且属于当前空间的真实文件 ID；输出来源的 fileId 保留此值。: An uploaded file ID belonging to the current workspace; preserve it in the output source fileId.
平台授权后提供的读取地址；不要用短期地址代替长期文件 ID。: A read URL authorized by the platform; never replace a persistent file ID with a temporary URL.
原始文件名，可作为内容标题；不用于判断权限。: Original filename, optionally used as the content title; never used for authorization.
文件实际 MIME，例如 image/png；由平台文件记录核实。: Actual file MIME type, such as image/png, verified against the platform file record.
字节数，用于处理限制和展示；不是字符数。: Size in bytes for limits and display; not a character count.
SDK 支持的可选内联数据；知识库录入使用已授权的文件 ID，无须用户填写二进制: Optional inline data supported by the SDK; knowledge ingestion uses authorized file IDs without requiring binary JSON.
待处理原文；与 files 至少提供一个，不要把二进制文件写成文本: Original text to process; provide text or files, and never encode binary files as text
内联文本默认 text/plain，也支持 text/markdown；文件 M: Defaults to text/plain for inline text; text/markdown is also supported; files use their own MIME types
仅兼容旧调用；与顶层 files、text、mime 不能混用，新实现优先使用原: Legacy calls only; cannot be combined with top-level files, text or mime; prefer native file and text parameters
与 files 至少提供一个；上传文件时通常省略。: Provide text or files; usually omitted when uploading files.
由平台核实；内联文本默认为 text/plain。: Verified by the platform; defaults to text/plain for inline text.
已授权的平台文件引用，最多 100 个且 MIME 一致；保留 id 作为 so: Authorized platform file references, at most 100 with one MIME type; preserve id as sources.fileId and read originals using the authorized URL.
处理器专属参数，由所选实现声明并校验；文本实现只接受空对象: Implementation-specific parameters declared and validated by the selected processor; the text implementation accepts only an empty object
带原件和块级来源的内容对象；schemaVersion 固定为 1，平台将校验后: Content with originals and block-level provenance; schemaVersion must be 1 and the platform validates it before ingestion
固定为 1；用于校验内容结构版本。: Must be 1; identifies the content schema version.
可选的人类可读标题，例如图片文件名或文章标题。: Optional human-readable title, such as an image filename or article title.
1–10,000 个原件或原文；来源 id 在本次内容内唯一。: 1–10,000 originals or source texts; source IDs must be unique within this content.
本次内容内唯一，例如 source-1；供 locators.sourceId: Unique within this content, such as source-1; referenced by locators.sourceId and assetIds.
text / pdf / image / audio / video / fil: text / pdf / image / audio / video / file / web; use the original content type.
取自 files 的真实 id（旧版 input.files）；与 url、非空: A real ID from files (legacy input.files); provide fileId, url or nonempty text; never invent IDs.
HTTP(S) 原文或原件地址；不得带用户名密码；与 fileId、非空 tex: HTTP(S) source URL without embedded credentials; provide url, fileId or nonempty text.
原件的 MIME，例如 image/png；优先保留平台传入的文件元数据。: Original MIME type, such as image/png; preserve platform-provided file metadata when available.
字符定位的基准；与 fileId、url 至少一项非空。: The basis for character locations; provide nonempty text, fileId or url.
每页声明 number、width、height；使用 pageNo 或 bbo: Declare number, width and height for each page; pageNo or bbox requires a matching page declaration.
从 1 开始，同一来源中不重复；单张图片使用第 1 页。: Starts at 1 and is unique within the source; use page 1 for a single image.
正数，PDF 单位 point，图片单位 pixel；使用原件真实尺寸。: Positive; PDF uses points and images use pixels; use actual original dimensions.
正数，与 width 使用相同单位；用于校验定位区域边界。: Positive, in the same units as width; used to validate location bounds.
音视频长度，单位毫秒，非负；声明后时间定位不得超出此范围。: Nonnegative audio/video duration in milliseconds; time locations must stay within this duration when declared.
1–10,000 个可检索、可引用的块；text 与 html 合计不超过 16: 1–10,000 searchable and citable blocks; combined text and html must not exceed 16 MiB of UTF-8 bytes.
本次内容内唯一，例如 block-1；供 derivedFrom 关联。: Unique within this content, such as block-1; referenced by derivedFrom.
text / title / list / quote / code / for: text / title / list / quote / code / formula / table / image / audio / video / file / header / footer / page_number.
OCR 文字、转写或段落正文；与非空 html、assetIds 至少一项。: OCR text, transcript or paragraph body; provide nonempty text, html or assetIds.
表格等富文本表达；建议同时提供 text 便于检索。: Rich text such as tables; also provide text for search when possible.
填写 sources 的 id，不是平台文件 ID；对应来源须有 fileId: IDs from sources, not platform file IDs; the referenced source must have fileId or url.
指向原件的页、区域、时间或文字范围；与 derivedFrom 至少一项非空。: Page, region, time or character locations in the original; provide nonempty locators or derivedFrom.
必须匹配 sources 中的 id；仅提供此字段表示定位到整份来源。: Must match an ID in sources; this field alone locates the entire source.
从 1 开始，必须在对应来源的 pages 中声明；有 bbox 时必填。: Starts at 1 and must be declared in the source pages; required with bbox.
矩形 {llx,lly,urx,ury}，非负、宽高为正且不越界；只使用真实坐标: Rectangle {llx,lly,urx,ury} with nonnegative coordinates and positive bounded dimensions; use actual coordinates and supply pageNo.
矩形的 X 下界，须 ≥ 0 且小于 urx；单位由 coordinateSpa: Lower X bound, at least 0 and below urx; units are specified by coordinateSpace.
矩形的 Y 下界，须 ≥ 0 且小于 ury；先按原件的坐标约定转换。: Lower Y bound, at least 0 and below ury; convert according to the original coordinate convention.
矩形的 X 上界，须大于 llx 且不超过页面 width。: Upper X bound, above llx and no greater than the page width.
矩形的 Y 上界，须大于 lly 且不超过页面 height。: Upper Y bound, above lly and no greater than the page height.
有 bbox 时必填：PDF 用 pdf_points，其他来源用 pixels: Required with bbox: pdf_points for PDF, pixels for other sources; omit without bbox.
音视频片段开始位置，单位毫秒；与 endMs 同时提供，0 ≤ startMs: Audio/video segment start in milliseconds; supply endMs too, with 0 ≤ startMs < endMs.
音视频片段结束位置，单位毫秒；大于 startMs 且不超过已声明的 durat: Audio/video segment end in milliseconds; greater than startMs and no greater than a declared durationMs.
[start,end) 的两个整数；按 Unicode 字符计数且位于 sour: Two integers defining [start,end), counted in Unicode characters within source.text, not bytes or UTF-16 code units.
摘要或合并内容引用已有块 id；必须存在且不能形成循环；与 locators 至: Existing block IDs for summaries or merged content; references must exist and be acyclic; provide nonempty derivedFrom or locators.
非致命处理提示；没有提示时返回空数组，不能用提示掩盖处理失败: Nonfatal processing messages; return an empty array when absent and never hide processing failures as warnings
